liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): Reviewer describes the opener as energetic [28]
- **Friend of the Devil** (1 review): Reviewer was impressed by the performance and by the stage lighting during this song [24]
- **Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Reviewer says Garcia's first-set playing on Minglewood is extraordinarily hot and unlike anything else they've heard [21]
- **Day Job** (1 review): Reviewer remembers it as the first time they heard the band play Day Job live [22]
- **Spoonful** (1 review): Reviewer remembers it as the first time they heard the band play Spoonful live [22]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): A Sugar Magnolia intro leading into Good Lovin' surprised the reviewer, showing how quickly the band could change direction [24]

## Setlist highlights

- **Sugar Magnolia Tease**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-10-08.fob.nak300.unknown.watson.100036.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 156 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Uploader says there are no cassette-flip cuts, but some hiss during quiet parts of Space; overall sounds awesome [1]
- **gd83-10-08.fob-aud.willy.11734.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 137 min; rated 3.83/5 by 18 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the FOB audience recording nice sounding [29]
- **gd1983-10-08.163814.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 18 songs; 142 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [9]
- **gd1983-10-08.143257.mke2002.holbrook.flac2448**: audience recording; 18 songs; 147 min [11]

## Around the show

- Reviewer was in Richmond for a job interview, learned of the show from the interviewer, and bought a ticket in the parking lot [22]
- Reviewer drove overnight from Harrisburg, got the second car in the lot, and says this opened the fall East Coast tour [23]
- Reviewer praises Richmond as a venue with excellent acoustics and a free-for-all open floor; the show fell on their birthday [28]
- Reviewer was a second-year UVa student who went to Richmond without a ticket with friends of friends and arrived early at the Coliseum [30]
- Reviewer drove from the Baltimore suburbs on I-95; the Orioles won the ALCS that day, which a fellow fan told them inside [31]
- Reviewer notes this show was the first with Mickey's balaphone and Bobby's Modulus guitar [32]
- Bobby told Candace it was a red light song, since she had lit the stage entirely blue [11]
- Reviewer thinks this show is underrated and guesses Garcia was fired up after a gap of a couple weeks without playing [21]
- Reviewer was annoyed that the first two songs, Stranger into Friend of the Devil, repeated the last East Coast show, City Island in June 1983 [23]
- Reviewer was also bothered that the opening songs matched those of the Harrisburg show [24]
- Reviewer finds the first set good through Cassidy, after which the show loses some energy [28]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-10-08.fob.nak300.unknown.watson.100036.flac16**: transferred by M. Watson; source: (FOB)Nak CM300->? [1]. Also: From Keith Litzenberger's DAT collection, labeled Nak300 to PCM to Apogee to DAT, though the uploader is unsure it's accurate [1]
- **gd83-10-08.fob-aud.willy.11734.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB-MC>DAT>CD [2]. Also: FOB microphone-capture to DAT to CD, patched with a Nak source, via Tommy Danscuk and seeded to etree by Willy [2]
- **gd1983-10-08.163814.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5M (Maxell XLII-S) [9]. Also: Transferred by Charlie Miller from Jim Vita's master cassettes; Sennheiser 441 source from Jeff Silberman supplies short patches in Drums and Space [9]
- **gd1983-10-08.143257.mke2002.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Executive Crew Chris Kidwell Tom Pinney Greg Martens; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Master: AUD MC Sennheiser mke2002 binaurals worn on head > Sony TCD5M no dolby Maxell MX90 x 2 Location: 75 feet from stage DFC [11]. Also: Binaural recording with microphones worn at the ears; uploader recommends headphones [11]

## Art and photos

Reviewer drove overnight from Harrisburg, got the second car in the lot, and says this opened the fall East Coast tour
Reviewer was annoyed that the first two songs, Stranger into Friend of the Devil, repeated the last East Coast show, City Island in June 1983
Reviewer was impressed by the performance and by the stage lighting during this song

Reviewer was also bothered that the opening songs matched those of the Harrisburg show

Reviewer describes the opener as energetic
Reviewer finds the first set good through Cassidy, after which the show loses some energy
Reviewer feels the rest of the show doesn't match the best of the other shows on this tour
Reviewer calls the FOB audience recording nice sounding
Reviewer was a second-year UVa student who went to Richmond without a ticket with friends of friends and arrived early at the Coliseum
